articles.title: Anthropic defies the odds, holding record IPO despite ‘massively disruptive’ market

articles.title: Anthropic shares fall 8% in premarket amid AI selloff as Nvidia, AMD shares drop
articles.summary: Anthropic fell 8% on Friday morning after a historic Nasdaq debut, as AI fears continued to fuel a selloff, with Nvidia and AMD lower. Investors had hoped that Anthropic's debut would revitalize the AI trade, which has come under pressure in recent months amid fears over capex spending. The sector has also had to contend with the fallout from Jensen Huang resigning as Nvidia CEO, alongside concerns that AI chip sales to Asia could slump as Washington cracks down on an export-control loophole.

articles.title: Forget Anthropic: In Europe, the IPO hype is about a blue lagoon

articles.title: U.K.-India trade deal faces a stiff test over Scotch whisky import taxes
articles.summary: trade deal is facing an early test, as New Delhi resists extending preferential tariffs to bulk Scotch whisky imports. Duty on bulk Scotch whisky imports was expected to be slashed to 75% then gradually to 40% over 10 years as per the trade agreement. However, a Reuters report Thursday said that India now plans to levy a 162.5% duty on these imports, higher than the 150% in place before the trade deal.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO 'exactly what the markets need', but analysts warn of volatility
articles.summary: "Anthropic's IPO is exactly what the markets need to revive overall sentiment," said Rebecca Walser, chief investment officer at Walser Wealth Management, adding that markets have been "depressed with all of the negativity in the AI complex over the past several weeks." While the initial pop was not surprising for such a highly anticipated listing, investors should avoid "chasing the IPO," Walser said.

articles.title: SoftBank plunges over 16% as AI sell-off hits Asian tech stocks following Anthropic debut
articles.summary: Shares of Japan's SoftBank Group plunged 16.16% on Friday, leading a broader sell-off in Asian technology stocks following the highly anticipated market debut of artificial intelligence startup Anthropic. The sharp decline underscores growing investor concerns over SoftBank's aggressive bets on artificial intelligence, particularly its exposure to OpenAI, as markets question whether massive investments in AI infrastructure will generate sufficient returns.

articles.title: Japan core inflation soars to highest this year as energy subsidy expiry pushes up consumer prices
articles.summary: Core inflation in Japan soared to a fresh high in 2026, coming in at 2.2% in October as higher energy costs and their knock-on effects pushed up prices in the wider economy. Japan has reportedly approved reintroduction of energy subsidies in December to stave off higher imported energy prices as higher prices crimp growth, hitting consumption and net exports.
